## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 350 captures during February 2019. This report provides a summary of activity for the month, including the number of images captured, the proportion that could not be graded, and the grading outcomes recorded. The capture total provides the overall activity measure for the clinic during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 350 captures, 14 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.0 per cent. The ungradable total and rate are reported together to show the level of image quality requiring consideration in the monthly results. These figures provide the basis for monitoring image quality at Harbour Eye Clinic.

## Grading

The grading results recorded 58 referable outcomes. The median lag for grading was 7 days. Together, these measures describe the number of results identified as referable and the typical time between capture and completion of grading during February 2019. The results should be considered alongside the activity and image quality measures for the month.
